_comment: Response headers for the viewer, shared by deploy/serve.mjs; nginx.conf and Caddyfile repeat them. wasm-unsafe-eval = WebAssembly.instantiate; style-src unsafe-inline = Svelte style attributes; blob: = PNG export and worker / canvas blobs.

all.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'
